def modulo(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    power = base % mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * power) % mod
        power = (power * power) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def main():

    else:
        sum_value = (modulo(half + other_half, total_cells, mod) + modulo(abs(half - other_half), total_cells, mod)) % mod
